'''Falrey''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Imperial officer|officer]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Are you an Imperial Officer?''"<br />"''Not enough of a disguise? No matter. You are a loyal citizen of the Empire, are you not? My senior officer, Captain Thrawn, has a mission of the utmost importance.|A spacer and Agent Falrey|<ref name="SWG:GIFSG" />}}
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], [[Agent/Legends|Agent]] Falrey served a [[Spy/Legends|spy]] under the orders of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]]. During that time, the Empire had an arrangement with the [[Rak'qua]], an aggressive tribe of [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolans]] living in [[Station Gamma]], a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] above [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] in the [[Bright Jewel system/Legends|Bright Jewel system]]. The Rak'qua had allowed the Empire to set up a communication system in Station Gamma.<ref name="SWG:GIFSG" /> However, In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the Nautolans had decided to put a lock on the Imperial communication system, preventing the Empire from communicating with its main [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] in the region. Captain Thrawn therefore tasked Falrey to investigate the situation. The Imperial Agent traveled to [[Tansarii Point Station/Legends|Tansarii Point Station]], a space station neighboring Station Gamma in the Bright Jewel system where he recruited a group of spacers loyal to the Empire. The spacers raided Station Gamma, killing a number of hostile Rak'qua during the attack, and successfully [[Slicer/Legends|sliced]] the Station Gamma [[Memory bank/Legends|databank]]. The spacers then returned safely to Tansarii Point Station and delivered the information to Agent Falrey.<ref name="SWG:GIFSG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Falrey appeared as a non-player character in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:GIFSG" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], 2011.<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Falrey was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:New Player Tutorial|New Player Tutorial]],"<ref name="SWG:GIFSG" /> introduced with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
